main_text.p: phetam confulit: ejufque refponfo edocetur, nihil ex hofte periculi fore, divinû autem auxilium non defuturum. Nec multo poft aTharaca id est 9* Tirchac rex Aethiopum reg num Aflyriorum invadit. Quo nuncio Sed in cod. Ebr. Thirhaca Sennacherib ad luatuenda converl us,fre- mens & clamitans, victori fibi victoriam eripi,bellum omisit:missis ad Ezechiali- teris,cum verborum contumeliis denun- cians,se paulo poft rebus domi composi- tis,ad excidium ludeae-maiure rediturum. haec pau-llo aliter Scriptura Sed nihil his Ezechias motus, orasse Do- minum traditur, ne hanc tantam hominis infolentiam inultam sineret. Ita eadem Sennache-rib ab-an- nocte angelus castra Assyriorum aggref- gelo cast[?] sus,multa hominum millia letho dedit. cixxxv[?] Rex trepidus in opidum Niniven confu- git, ibique a filiis interfectus, dignum se exitium tulit. Per idem tempus Ezechias, Esai.38[?] æger corpore,morbo incubuerat. Cum- que Esaias ei verbum Domini annunci- asset, vitæ ejus finem adesse, flesle rex tra- ditur. ita xv. annos prorogari sibi ad vi- 4.Reg.19[?] tam meruit. Quibus peractis,nono & vi- gefimo imperii anno decefsit: regnum Manasse filio reliquit. Is a patre multu de- generas, relicto Domino,culturas impia

page.notes: Right margin notes are transcribed beside the text where they stand; readings marked [?] are uncertain. The note "cixxxv[?]" is a faint numeral mark and may be misread. The margin note at "Esai.38" and "4.Reg.19" are read from a small, faint scan and may be inaccurate. The printed "Ε" in "aTharaca" and "Sed in cod. Ebr." may be Hebrew or Greek; I could not confirm the letters. The page number may be "§3" in the scan, read here as 83. The ending "impia" is cut off at the foot and continues on the next page.
